content: Alibaba Cloud CSPM baseline (per Alibaba Security Center's own configuration-assessment checks and Trend Micro Conformity rules): OSS bucket ACL not public-read/public-read-write, OSS server-side encryption enabled, OSS access logging enabled, RAM least-privilege (no AdministratorAccess on individual RAM users, MFA enforced for console users, unused RAM credentials removed/rotated), ECS security group rules not open to 0.0.0.0/0 on admin ports (22/3389), RDS/ApsaraDB instances not publicly accessible + encryption at rest, ActionTrail (Alibaba's CloudTrail equivalent) enabled account-wide for audit logging. These mirror AWS-equivalent checks 1:1 (RAM~IAM, OSS~S3, ActionTrail~CloudTrail, Security Group~SG), which is useful for reusing the AWS_CHECKS naming/structure as a template.
